skills.title: Decision-Grade Research
skills.summary: Turn a real decision under uncertainty into an auditable research report with a hypothesis tree, parallel evidence tracks, adversarial Track-D, conflict adjudication, and a source-linked evidence ledger.
skills.origin_note: generalized public workflow for decision research and consulting-style evidence review

skills.title: Project WIP Auditor
skills.summary: Scan local project roots and reconstruct what is active, stalled, dormant, or abandoned, then produce a WIP decision board with resume, ship, kill, or archive recommendations.
skills.origin_note: generalized public workflow for read-only local project workspace audits

skills.title: Pre-mortem Red Team
skills.summary: Stress-test a plan by assuming it failed, attacking load-bearing assumptions, ranking failure modes, defining monitoring thresholds and mitigations, and optionally checking fact-sensitive assumptions with a search adapter.
skills.origin_note: public method workflow for pre-mortem and red-team plan review

skills.title: all2md
skills.summary: Convert mixed source-material packages into AI-ready Markdown by routing documents, PDFs, images, audio, and video through available local tools while preserving folder structure and writing index plus manifest artifacts.
skills.origin_note: public source-preparation workflow for multimodal research and diligence packages

skills.title: agent-chart
skills.summary: Generate PPT-ready static charts from local CSV, Excel, or pasted data through an explicit chart spec, validation pass, and deterministic Python renderer that exports PNG, SVG, and saved specs.
skills.origin_note: public chart-generation workflow for local business analysis data and consulting-style report assets
